title: Controls & tactile inputs
summary: Buttons, toggles, pickers and fields with real pressed states and no layout jump.

components.name: Disclosure chevron
components.summary: A trigger whose chevron rotates as the hidden section opens.
called: the little arrow that turns when you open it
show more toggle with a triangle
caret that points down when the section is open

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.text: The whole row is the button, not just the arrow. It announces open or closed.

anatomy.name: Chevron
anatomy.text: Points right when closed and down when open, turning in about 140ms.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.text: The hidden content. It animates its height and leaves the tab order when closed.

components.prompt: Add a disclosure: a <button aria-expanded aria-controls> with a chevron that rotates 90° in 140ms ease-out, and a panel that animates height with grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr. Hide the closed panel with visibility: hidden so its links leave the tab order.
components.debug: Debug my disclosure. Rule out: aria-expanded not updating; a closed panel at height 0 that still takes focus; a chevron rotating around the wrong origin; a transition on height: auto that snaps instead of animating; the click handler on the icon instead of the whole button. The symptom:

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Stacked headings that expand one answer at a time, with arrow-key travel between them.
called: faq where clicking a question shows the answer
stacked sections that open one at a time
questions with a plus that expands

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.text: Each question is a real heading with a button inside, so screen readers can jump between them.

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.text: The chevron flips when its panel opens.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.text: The answer. Opening one closes the others unless the accordion allows several.

components.prompt: Add an accordion: each item is an <h3> containing a <button aria-expanded aria-controls>, and a panel with role="region" aria-labelledby the button. One panel open at a time by default; Up and Down arrows move between headers, Home and End jump. Animate height with grid-template-rows.
components.debug: Debug my accordion. Rule out: buttons not inside headings; every panel opening because state is shared; arrow keys scrolling the page instead of moving focus; panel content still focusable while closed; layout jumping because the panel height is animated with max-height guesses. The symptom:

components.name: Tree view
components.summary: Nested folders and files with expand, collapse and full keyboard travel.
called: file explorer list with folders that open
sidebar that shows files inside folders

anatomy.name: Branch
anatomy.text: An item with children. Right opens it, Left closes it.

anatomy.name: Twisty
anatomy.text: The small arrow that shows whether a branch is open.

anatomy.name: Group
anatomy.text: The indented children, drawn against a thin guide line.

anatomy.name: Selected item
anatomy.text: The current item, tinted with the accent.

components.prompt: Add a tree view: role="tree" on the list, role="treeitem" on items, role="group" on nested lists, aria-expanded on branches and aria-selected on the current item. Up and Down move through visible items, Right expands or steps in, Left collapses or steps out, Enter selects. Use a roving tabindex.
components.debug: Debug my tree view. Rule out: every item having tabindex 0; arrow keys moving into collapsed branches; aria-expanded on leaves; nested lists without role="group"; the twisty as the only clickable area. The symptom:

components.name: Theme switch
components.summary: A light/dark switch with a springy thumb and a circular reveal of the new theme.
called: sun and moon toggle for dark mode
night mode switch in the corner
the button that flips the site dark

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.text: The pill behind the thumb. It turns accent-coloured in dark mode.

anatomy.name: Thumb
anatomy.text: Slides across on a slight spring and widens while pressed.

anatomy.name: Idle glyph
anatomy.text: The mode you are not in rests faintly on the far side.

components.prompt: Add a light/dark switch: a <button role="switch" aria-checked aria-label="Dark mode"> with a track and a thumb that slides on cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.4, 0.5, 1). Set data-mode on <html>, persist the choice, apply it from an inline head script before paint, and reveal the new theme with a circular View Transition from the switch where supported.
components.debug: Debug my theme switch. Rule out: a flash of the wrong theme on load (apply it in an inline head script); the switch state not matching the page after reload; localStorage throwing in private mode; the reveal running under reduced motion; icons rotating around the wrong centre. The symptom:

components.name: Segmented control
components.summary: A pill row where a sliding indicator follows the selected option.
called: pill buttons where one is highlighted
the sliding background behind the selected tab

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.text: One raised pill that glides to the selected option on a spring.

anatomy.name: Selected segment
anatomy.text: The current choice. Arrow keys move and select in one step.

anatomy.name: Segment
anatomy.text: Each option is a short label, never more than about five of them.

components.prompt: Add a segmented control: role="radiogroup" with buttons role="radio", one indicator element that moves with transform to the selected button (spring easing), arrow keys that move and select, roving tabindex, and tabular numbers for time ranges.
components.debug: Debug my segmented control. Rule out: the indicator measured before fonts load (re-measure with a ResizeObserver); every segment in the tab order; the indicator animating on first paint; labels wrapping and changing height. The symptom:

components.name: Toggle switch
components.summary: An on/off settings switch on a native checkbox, with a squash on press.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.text: Turns accent-coloured when on.

anatomy.name: Thumb
anatomy.text: Slides with a small overshoot and squashes while held.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Says what turns on. Clicking it toggles too.

components.prompt: Add a settings switch: a native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside a <label>, visually hidden, with a styled track and thumb. The change applies immediately; never pair a switch with a Save button.
components.debug: Debug my switch. Rule out: the input set to display: none (it loses focus and form submission); clicks on the label not toggling; the thumb transition on left instead of transform; a switch that only applies after Save. The symptom:

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Animated tick that draws itself, with a select-all box that goes indeterminate.
called: select all box with a dash

anatomy.name: Parent box
anatomy.text: Shows a dash when only some children are ticked.

anatomy.name: Checked box
anatomy.text: The tick draws itself in about 200ms.

anatomy.name: Disabled item
anatomy.text: Dimmed and skipped by Tab.

components.prompt: Add checkboxes on native <input type="checkbox"> with a drawn SVG tick (stroke-dashoffset animation) and a select-all parent that sets input.indeterminate when some, but not all, children are checked.
components.debug: Debug my checkbox. Rule out: indeterminate set as an HTML attribute (it only exists as a property); the input hidden with display: none; the tick path not getting stroke-dasharray; focus ring drawn on the hidden input instead of the visible box. The symptom:

components.name: Radio group
components.summary: A single-choice list where the dot grows into place.
called: round buttons where you pick one

anatomy.name: Legend
anatomy.text: Names the question the options answer.

anatomy.name: Selected dot
anatomy.text: The ring thickens into a dot.

anatomy.name: Option
anatomy.text: The whole row is clickable.

components.prompt: Add a radio group: native radios sharing a name inside a <fieldset> with a <legend>. Arrow keys move the selection natively. Style the dot by growing the border width with a spring.
components.debug: Debug my radio group. Rule out: radios with different name attributes; a missing legend; inputs hidden with display: none; a default selection missing when one option is the sensible default. The symptom:

components.name: Radio cards
components.summary: Plan or option cards that select as a whole, with a check badge.
called: cards you click to choose a plan

anatomy.name: Selected card
anatomy.text: Gets an accent outline and a filled check badge.

anatomy.name: Check badge
anatomy.text: Pops in on selection.

anatomy.name: Price
anatomy.text: Numbers line up across cards.

components.prompt: Add radio cards: each card is a <label> around a visually hidden radio, styled with :has(input:checked) for the selected outline and a check badge. Keep the whole card clickable and show the focus ring on the card.
components.debug: Debug my radio cards. Rule out: clicks on inner text not selecting (the card must be the label); focus ring missing because it is on the hidden input; cards changing height when selected; :has() unsupported fallbacks. The symptom:

components.name: OTP code input
components.summary: Six boxes that auto-advance, accept a pasted code and backspace across fields.
called: six separate boxes for the sms code
enter the code we sent you

anatomy.name: First box
anatomy.text: Lets the phone offer the code from the SMS.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.text: Splits six digits into two easy groups of three.

anatomy.name: Status
anatomy.text: Says when the code is accepted or wrong.

components.prompt: Add a one-time-code input: six inputs with inputmode="numeric", the first with autocomplete="one-time-code". Typing advances, Backspace on an empty box goes back, arrow keys move, and pasting a full code fills every box. Announce success or error in a role="status".
components.debug: Debug my OTP input. Rule out: paste only filling the first box; autocomplete="one-time-code" missing so iOS does not offer the code; maxlength stopping a pasted string from arriving; focus jumping on every keystroke including Shift. The symptom:

components.name: Range slider
components.summary: A slider that snaps magnetically to detents and shows its value in a live bubble.
called: the dot you drag to change the volume

anatomy.name: Track and thumb
anatomy.text: Native, so keyboard, touch and screen readers work for free.

anatomy.name: Detents
anatomy.text: Values the thumb snaps to when dragged close.

anatomy.name: Readout
anatomy.text: The current value in tabular numbers.

components.prompt: Add a range slider on <input type="range"> with a filled track (a gradient at --pct), tick marks at detents that the thumb snaps to while dragging, and a value bubble shown on hover, focus and drag. Keep keyboard steps exact.
components.debug: Debug my slider. Rule out: snapping applied to keyboard steps too; the fill not updating on input (only on change); Firefox needing ::-moz-range-progress; the bubble positioned without accounting for thumb width. The symptom:

components.name: Dual-thumb range slider
components.summary: Pick a minimum and maximum on one track; the thumbs never cross.
called: price range slider with two handles

anatomy.name: Selected range
anatomy.text: The accent band between the two thumbs.

anatomy.name: Minimum thumb
anatomy.text: Cannot pass the maximum; the gap is enforced.

anatomy.name: Readout
anatomy.text: Both values, formatted with the currency.

components.prompt: Add a dual-thumb range slider: two overlapping range inputs with pointer-events only on their thumbs, a fill between them, a minimum gap so they never cross, and aria-valuetext with formatted values.
components.debug: Debug my dual slider. Rule out: the top input swallowing clicks for the bottom thumb (set pointer-events: none on the inputs, auto on thumbs); thumbs crossing; the last-moved thumb not raised when both meet. The symptom:

components.name: Button suite
components.summary: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and icon buttons with press scale and a no-jump loading state.
called: button that shows a spinner when saving
square button with just an icon

anatomy.name: Primary
anatomy.text: One per view. Accent fill, ink text.

anatomy.name: Ghost
anatomy.text: The quiet option, for Cancel and back.

anatomy.name: Icon button
anatomy.text: Square, with an accessible name.

anatomy.name: Loading
anatomy.text: The label keeps its space so the button never changes width.

components.prompt: Add a button set: primary (accent fill), secondary (outline), ghost, destructive and icon-only (square, aria-label). Press scales to 0.97 in 90ms. Loading keeps the label in the layout with visibility: hidden and overlays a spinner, so the width never jumps.
components.debug: Debug my button. Rule out: width changing when the spinner replaces the label; disabled buttons still firing; the press scale applied while disabled; icon-only buttons without a name; two primary buttons in one view. The symptom:

components.name: Split button
components.summary: A main action joined to a menu of related actions.
called: button with a dropdown arrow on the side
save and the little arrow next to it

anatomy.name: Main action
anatomy.text: The default thing most people want.

anatomy.name: Menu toggle
anatomy.text: Opens related actions. Down arrow opens it from the keyboard.

anatomy.name: Menu
anatomy.text: Alternatives to the main action, each with a short explanation.

components.prompt: Add a split button: a main <button> joined to a second button with aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded that opens role="menu" with role="menuitem" options. Down opens on the first item, Up on the last, Esc closes and returns focus.
components.debug: Debug my split button. Rule out: the toggle with no accessible name; the menu closing before a click registers (use pointerdown outside); focus not returning to the toggle on Esc; the two halves with different heights. The symptom:

components.name: Copy button
components.summary: Copies text and morphs its icon into a check, then back.
aliases: copy icon that turns into tick
called: click to copy icon that turns into a tick
clipboard icon next to a code

anatomy.name: Icon morph
anatomy.text: The copy icon turns into a tick for about 1.6s.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Reserved width, so "Copy" to "Copied" never shifts layout.

anatomy.name: Copied text
anatomy.text: What lands on the clipboard.

components.prompt: Add a copy button: navigator.clipboard.writeText with a textarea fallback, morph the copy icon into a check for 1.6s, swap the label to "Copied" without changing width, and announce it in a polite live region.
components.debug: Debug my copy button. Rule out: clipboard blocked on http or in iframes without permission; the label change shifting layout; repeated clicks stacking timers; no announcement for screen readers. The symptom:

components.name: Tag input
components.summary: Type and press Enter to add chips; extra chips collapse into a +n counter.
called: type and press enter to add tags
pills with x inside an input

anatomy.name: Chip
anatomy.text: One value, with its own remove button.

anatomy.name: Overflow count
anatomy.text: Extra chips collapse until the field is focused.

anatomy.name: Entry
anatomy.text: Enter or comma adds; Backspace on empty removes the last chip.

components.prompt: Add a tag input: chips as a list with remove buttons (aria-label "Remove x"), a text input that adds on Enter or comma and removes the last chip on Backspace when empty, and a +n count that collapses extras while unfocused.
components.debug: Debug my tag input. Rule out: Enter submitting the form; duplicates; remove buttons without names; Backspace deleting a chip while the input still has text; focus lost after removing a chip. The symptom:

components.name: Search input
components.summary: A search field with a clear button and a keyboard-shortcut badge that focuses it.
called: search box with a keyboard shortcut hint
search bar with an x to clear
filter field at the top of a list

anatomy.name: Field
anatomy.text: Esc clears it; the browser cancel button is replaced.

anatomy.name: Shortcut badge
anatomy.text: Shows the key that focuses the field from anywhere.

anatomy.name: Leading icon
anatomy.text: Decoration; the label is visually hidden but present.

components.prompt: Add a search field: <input type="search"> with a visually hidden label, a leading search icon, a clear button that appears with text, Esc to clear, and a ⌘/Ctrl + key shortcut (shown as a <kbd> badge) that focuses it.
components.debug: Debug my search field. Rule out: the shortcut firing while typing in another input; the clear button not refocusing the field; a missing label; the native cancel button showing twice. The symptom:

components.name: Text field
components.summary: Floating-label input with helper text and inline validation on blur.
called: input where the label floats up when you type
email field with a red error under it

anatomy.name: Floating label
anatomy.text: Sits in the field, then shrinks above it on focus or once filled.

anatomy.name: Helper or error
anatomy.text: Help text that turns into a specific error after you leave the field.

anatomy.name: Valid tick
anatomy.text: Confirms a field is fine, quietly.

components.prompt: Add text fields with a floating label (placeholder=" " and :placeholder-shown), helper text linked by aria-describedby, and validation on blur that sets aria-invalid and replaces the helper with a specific message ("Use a full address, like name@company.com").
components.debug: Debug my text field. Rule out: validating on every keystroke before the first blur; placeholder used as the only label; aria-invalid left true after fixing; error text not linked by aria-describedby; label overlapping autofilled values. The symptom:

components.name: Date range picker
components.summary: A calendar popover for picking a start and end date with arrow-key travel.
called: calendar popup to pick from and to dates

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.text: Shows the chosen range in tabular numbers.

anatomy.name: Range start
anatomy.text: First click sets the start; the second sets the end.

anatomy.name: Range band
anatomy.text: The days between, tinted with the accent.

anatomy.name: Apply
anatomy.text: Commits the range and closes the calendar.

components.prompt: Add a date range picker: a trigger button opening a non-modal dialog with a role="grid" calendar. Arrow keys move by day and week, PageUp/PageDown by month, Enter picks start then end, hovering previews the range, Esc closes and returns focus.
components.debug: Debug my date range picker. Rule out: timezone shifts turning 10 Nov into 9 Nov (construct dates at noon); weeks starting on Sunday when users expect Monday; arrow keys scrolling the page; the end date allowed before the start. The symptom:

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: A searchable select that filters as you type, with arrows, Enter and Esc.
called: dropdown you can type in to search

anatomy.name: Input
anatomy.text: Focus stays here while arrows move through options.

anatomy.name: Listbox
anatomy.text: The filtered options.

anatomy.name: Match highlight
anatomy.text: The typed letters, underlined in each option.

components.prompt: Add a combobox: <input role="combobox" aria-expanded aria-controls aria-autocomplete="list"> with a role="listbox". Filter as the user types, move the active option with arrows using aria-activedescendant (focus stays in the input), Enter chooses, Esc closes.
components.debug: Debug my combobox. Rule out: moving real focus into the list; aria-activedescendant pointing at a hidden option; the list closing on mousedown before the click lands; no empty state. The symptom:

components.name: File dropzone
components.summary: Drag files in or browse; shows each file with its size and a remove button.

anatomy.name: Drop zone
anatomy.text: Highlights while a file is dragged over it.

anatomy.name: Browse link
anatomy.text: The whole zone is a label for a native file input.

anatomy.name: Rules
anatomy.text: Says which file types and sizes are allowed, before anyone tries.

components.prompt: Add a file dropzone: a <label> wrapping a native <input type="file" multiple accept>, a dashed zone that highlights on dragenter (count enter/leave to avoid flicker), and a list of chosen files with sizes and remove buttons.
components.debug: Debug my dropzone. Rule out: highlight flickering because dragleave fires on children; the browser opening the dropped file (call preventDefault on dragover and drop); the same file not re-selectable (reset input.value). The symptom:

components.name: Number stepper
components.summary: Minus and plus buttons around a number, with hold-to-repeat and limits.
called: quantity picker with plus and minus
number box with buttons on each side

anatomy.name: Decrease
anatomy.text: Disabled at the minimum. Hold to repeat.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Typed values are clamped on change.

anatomy.name: Increase
anatomy.text: Disabled at the maximum.

components.prompt: Add a number stepper: − and + buttons around a native number input with min, max and step. Buttons repeat while held, accelerating; typed values clamp on change; buttons disable at the limits.
components.debug: Debug my stepper. Rule out: the repeat timer never cleared on pointerup outside the button; typed values outside the range accepted; spin buttons from the browser showing; non-numeric input on mobile (inputmode). The symptom:

components.name: Star rating
components.summary: Five stars on native radios: hover previews, arrows change it, the caption says it in words.
called: stars you click to rate something

anatomy.name: Star
anatomy.text: The radio carries state; the label draws the star.

anatomy.name: Caption
anatomy.text: Says the score in words, not just a number.

components.prompt: Add a star rating: five native radios in a fieldset with a legend, labels drawing filled stars up to the hovered or checked one, arrow keys from the browser, and an <output> caption that says the score in words ("4 of 5 · Very useful").
components.debug: Debug my star rating. Rule out: stars as divs with click handlers (no keyboard); radios hidden with display: none (unfocusable); no visible focus ring; hover preview that sticks after the pointer leaves. The symptom:

components.name: Billing period toggle
components.summary: Monthly or yearly with a sliding pill, a savings badge and a price that swaps in place.
called: monthly yearly switch on a pricing page
toggle that shows the annual discount

components.prompt: Add a billing period toggle above the pricing cards: a radiogroup pill with Monthly and Yearly, a "Save 20%" badge on Yearly, a sliding indicator, and every price on the page swapping between data-monthly and data-yearly values with a short fade-up. Default to yearly.
components.debug: Debug my billing toggle. Rule out: prices that jump width (use tabular figures and a min width); a checkbox switch where the label does not say which side is on; savings badge on both options; the indicator measured before fonts load. The symptom:

colour dots with a hex box

components.debug: Debug my colour picker. Rule out: swatches with no accessible names; a ring in a fixed colour that vanishes on similar swatches; validation that fires on every keystroke; low-contrast text on the tinted preview. The symptom:

components.name: Time-slot picker

pick a time for a call

components.prompt: Add a pricing calculator: two labelled range sliders (seats, usage) with live <output> values beside the labels, a monthly/yearly pill switch with the saving shown, and a result area with a large tabular total, the period, and the sum written out ("12 seats × £19 + 5m rows × £17").
